en.t: ...The stationmaster went to answer the telephone.

units.source_text: 不一会儿又走到镜子前，端端正正地戴上镶有金边的制帽，

en.t: Before long he walked back to the mirror and carefully put on his uniform cap with the gold trim,

units.source_text: 清了清嗓子，挺起胸脯，仿佛要出席什么仪式议的，来到了雨后的月台上。

en.t: cleared his throat, thrust out his chest, and came onto the rain-washed platform as though he were about to attend some ceremony.

units.source_text: 转瞬间，我应乘坐的列车发出轰隆隆声，沿着悬崖峭壁上的铁路传送过来。

en.t: In the next instant, the train I was to take sent its rumbling sound along the tracks on the cliffside as it approached.

units.source_text: 那轰隆声带有一种从而后的崖上传来的濡湿了的新鲜感。

en.t: That rumble carried a damp freshness, as if it had come from the cliff beyond.
